description: This file defines an interface class IOcdmSessionClient for handling CDM session events such as processing challenges, key updates, and errors within the Rialto media server component.

classes.name: IOcdmSessionClient
classes.description: An interface class for handling CDM session callbacks including challenge processing, key updates, and error notifications.

methods.name: onProcessChallenge
methods.description: Handles processing of challenge data with URL and challenge buffer.

methods.name: onKeyUpdated
methods.description: Notifies when a key's status has been updated, given the key ID.

methods.name: onAllKeysUpdated
methods.description: Notifies that all key statuses have been updated.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles error messages related to the CDM session.
